svg.title: OPENLAB wind turbine model — blade and hub template (A4, 1:1)
svg.desc: Three tapered blades cut from a PET bottle or thin plastic sheet, plus a hub disc. The blade root is 25 mm wide, the tip 12 mm; twist each blade 15–20 degrees at the hub when mounting. Hub disc has a 5 mm centre hole for a 608-bearing axle spacer or a pencil.

g.text: OPENLAB / wind-turbine-blade.svg — red = cut from a 2 L PET bottle side wall (curve gives camber)
Blades: root 25 mm, tip 12 mm, length 120 mm. Mount with a 15–20° pitch; bend the root at the dashed radial lines.
Hub: 70 mm disc from bottle-base plastic or card; 5 mm centre hole. Balance by trimming the heaviest tip.
